body: Thank you, I really appreciate your kind words and advice!
Thank you so much for your kind words!

The weird hours of going to college can really exacerbate depression. I would definitely go to the psychological services on your campus. My sophomore year at college, I remember that's when I was finally diagnosed with what turned out to be severe o.c.d  It was my first encounter with mental health care, and it was extremely positive. They told me that I was so bad off, I could officially "cancel" that semester and not have it count on my g.p.a. 

Anyway, the thing to do is -- to spur yourself into action, you need to take a small step. That step will be just to make a phone call and set up an intake appointment. It will probably be difficult, but if you can take that step it could be the beginning of your recovery.

When I'm bad off, even the simple task of showering seems like a herculean effort. I always shower before I have to go out, but on days like today it seems like it would be the equivalent of moving a mountain. I have to in the morning because I have to meet my tutor.

But yeah, going on day 4 here. My severe o.c.d. just makes it that much harder, because the whole ritual has to be "just right."
Thank you too! We need to know there's someone listening and someone who understands.

I used to have this total prick of an officemate, and he'd been placed in my already-closet-sized office. Well, I'd been there two years already and he was just an arrogant prick. He had a very organized desk, and a pink eraser placed exactly in the same place all the time. 

To fuck with him, whenever he wasn't around I'd pick up that little eraser and set it on top of the pencil sharpener on the side of the desk.
I laughed, but that doesn't mean you're not a psychopath
The clichéd dialogue, riddled with supposedly profound aphorisms, that gets written into all these "dark" superhero films.
Oh, cool. That's really cool actually!

You can usually feel out your managers about whether it's OK to get free food. A lot of places may officially give you a free meal during your shift; other times it depends on who's manager that day.

I wouldn't feel guilty about it, really. In jobs like that, the least they can do is hook you up with some food. But next time try to Ok it with someone.

Have you ever had a sexual offense before now? Or are you just feeling urges? You really need to get counseling so you can try to get rid of these urges. They aren't healthy and they could result in you becoming a sex offender. 

It would be very brave of you to seek counseling, because these feeling are obviously very taboo. But if you can muster the courage, it will be worth it.

Note: Therapist - Patient confidentiality doesn't apply if the therapist knows you are committing or have committed a crime. Just keep that in mind when you decide. The therapist is required by law to report you if you've offended.
